mapper.select: select id, dashboard_id, token, data_scope, password_hash, expire_time, publisher_actor_json, status, create_by, create_time from bi_dashboard_share where dashboard_id = #{dashboardId} and status = '0' order by id desc
select id, dashboard_id, token, data_scope, password_hash, expire_time, publisher_actor_json, status, create_by, create_time from bi_dashboard_share where token = #{token} and status = '0'
select id, dashboard_id, token, data_scope, password_hash, expire_time, publisher_actor_json, status, create_by, create_time from bi_dashboard_share where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into bi_dashboard_share (dashboard_id, token, data_scope, password_hash, expire_time, publisher_actor_json, status, create_by) values (#{dashboardId}, #{token}, #{dataScope}, #{passwordHash}, #{expireTime}, #{publisherActorJson}, '0', #{createBy})
